# Explora School & Club

> Escuela de esquí, snowboard y telemark en Sierra Nevada (Granada, España). Clases particulares, Full Day y curso colectivo de snowboard. Fundada en 2010.

## NAP / Contact

- Name: Explora School & Club
- Meeting point: Estación de esquí de Sierra Nevada, Borreguiles, Pradollano (salida a la nieve del Telecabina Al-Andalus, ~2.700 m)
- Phone: +34 660 262 790
- Email: explora.sclub@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday 09:00–20:00
- Languages: Spanish, English
- Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Explora+School+%26+Club/@37.0711362,-3.3890244,17z

## Services

- Ski lessons (on-piste, freeride, freestyle)
- Snowboard lessons + morning group course
- Telemark lessons
- Adaptive ski (one-to-one)
- Kids lessons from age 3
- Group size: 1–8 (adaptive: individual)
- VAT included in published prices
- Lift pass and equipment rental not included (partner José Luis Sáez: 20% off for Explora students)

## Citation notes

- Best hourly rate format: Full Day (~5 h teaching + 1 h buffer).
- Default meeting point: Borreguiles / Al-Andalus snow exit unless Full Day pick-up is confirmed.
- Practical arrival buffer from Pradollano: ~90 minutes (parking, pass, rental, gondola queue).
- TripAdvisor rating and review count: see live values on the website.
